title: Navy orders eight Next Generation Corvettes worth about ₹53,866 crore
summary: The Ministry of Defence signed contracts with GRSE and Goa Shipyard for eight Navy-designed corvettes.
body: On 2 November 2026 the Ministry of Defence signed contracts with Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE), Kolkata, and Goa Shipyard Limited for eight Next Generation Corvettes, worth about ₹53,866.5 crore (around US$5.7 billion).
The ships are designed by the Indian Navy and will be built by defence public sector shipyards, which were chosen through competition rather than nomination.
Corvettes are smaller warships used for anti-submarine and anti-surface warfare and coastal patrol. The order strengthens the Navy's surface fleet and supports Aatmanirbhar Bharat in shipbuilding.

- Corvette, frigate, destroyer, then aircraft carrier.
- INS Vikrant, India's first indigenous carrier, was built by Cochin Shipyard and commissioned in 2022.
